data.name: Preeti
data.gender_notes: Preeti is used as a female name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit root prī, 'to please, love' — prīti, 'love, delight'. Its root is Sanskrit prī (प्री). A classical Sanskrit term for love. Preeti is a Sanskrit name meaning “Love; affection; delight”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Preeti expresses “Love; affection; delight”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit root prī, 'to please, love' — prīti, 'love, delight'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Preeti total 37, reducing to 1. Number 1 is associated with leadership, independence and initiative.
